"content": "## Suite file format (YAML)

Save suites under `.mcpjam/evals/`. The page's example uses these top-level keys:

``

`yaml
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
 id: s_notes_example
 name: Notes server
ta

rget:
 servers:
 - name: notes # bound to a local MCP config entry
defaults:
 judge:
 enabled: false
 mo

del: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
 iterations: 1
 passThreshold: 1
 validity: {}
 toolPolicy: # optional; enf

orced before each MCP call
 allow: []
 deny: []
cases:
 - id: c_reads_a_note
 title: reads the note it was asked ab

out
 steps:
 - id: s1
 kind: prompt
 prompt: What does note 7 say?
 - id: a1
 kind: assert

assertion:
 type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
 toolName: read_note
```

Each case holds ordered `steps`
. A `prompt` step sends text to the model, and an `assert` step grades the transcript. The page also shows `toolNeverCalled` as an
assertion type. Direct `toolCall` steps, `interact` steps, and some result-based assertions are refused locally.\n\n## Run comman

d and flags

```bash
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=[REDACTED]
mcpjam test .mcpjam/evals/example.yaml
```

| Flag | Purpose |
|
- | - |\n| `--case <id>` | Run only an exact case id (repeatable) |\n| `--reporter json-summary\\|junit-xml\\|html` | Write that r
eport format to stdout |\n| `--out <path>` | Write the report to a file |\n| `--format human\\|json` | Terminal summary or JSON (d
efault depends on whether stdout is a TTY) |\n| `--server <name>=<url>` | Bind a target server to an HTTP(S) URL (repeatable) |\n|
`--url` / `--command` | Bind a single-target suite directly |\n| `--mcp-config <path>` | Explicit MCP JSON config |\n| `--inferen
ce auto\\|byok\\|mcpjam` | Choose model routing |\n| `--host <template>` | Emulate a host template |\n| `--allow-approximated <cas
e>` + `--approval-reason \"...\"` | Approve an approximated imported case |\n| `--api-key`, `--project`, `--api-url`, `--api-heade

r` | MCPJam-hosted inference and platform settings |
| `--no-telemetry` | Disable the CLI's anonymous telemetry event |

Exampl

e with a report:

```bash
mcpjam test .mcpjam/evals/example.yaml --case c_reads_a_note --reporter junit-xml --out reports/local

.xml
```

Server bindings resolve in this order: `--server`, then `--mcp-config`, then `./.mcp.json`, then `./.mcpjam/mcp.json`
. Exit codes: `0` passed, `1` failed, `2` invalid input, `3` credential failure, `4` setup failure, `5` inconclusive or interrupte

d.

## Cloud eval usage

The page covers only a few cloud eval commands:

- `mcpjam cloud login`: signs in locally. CI can i
nstead set `MCPJAM_API_KEY` to an organization `sk_` key.\n- `mcpjam cloud link`: sets the linked project.\n- `mcpjam cloud eval v
alidate --file <file>`: checks a suite offline, with no account.\n- `mcpjam cloud eval run --file <file>`: runs a hosted suite, an
d is needed for hosted-only capabilities.\n- `mcpjam cloud eval update --effort <level>`: sets reasoning effort on a hosted suite'
s model.\n\nLocal runs require an MCPJam login or `sk_` key to start, as the page notes for the upcoming SDK 10, CLI 6, and Vitest
0.3 releases. For details on the hosted run flags, see the CLI reference the page links to; this page does not document them."}]}
